assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is ordered
This service directly addresses the diagnosed paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and the associated cerebral ischemic episodes
making it medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential arrhythmic events
